newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nordic Aluminium clarifies issue pricing.
newsitem.headline: Nordic Aluminium clarifies issue pricing.

text.p: Finnish aluminium profiles and components maker Nordic Aluminium said on Wednesday it did not plan to offer shares outside its 45-53 markka price range, but reserved the right to do so as is normal in book-building.

The company was clarifying an earlier statement that the price range in its initial public offering from April 10 was 45-53 markka, with the maximum price for retail investors 53 markka. It said then institutions may pay above or below this.
Nordic Aluminium managing director Kari Blomberg later said it was "by no means the message" that some investors would pay outside the range: "It is a normal reservation".
